findings.label: sanitizeRoom ObjectId guard is not a guard
findings.detail: `typeof member.user === 'object'` is true for an ObjectId, so `delete member.user.phone` runs on unpopulated members instead of skipping them. Harmless no-op, no payload effect, but the comment and backend-verification.md both claim those members are skipped. Tighten the check or correct the comment.

findings.label: Link query cost is not bounded by skip/limit
findings.detail: getRoomMedia's link half is an unindexed `content: /https?:\/\//i` match plus a createdAt sort; skip/limit bound the rows returned, not the documents examined. Every user is a member of the universal room, so any authenticated caller can run this against the largest message set even though the group-info sheet never opens there. Correct the comment and consider refusing the universal room or capping the scan.

findings.label: Index attribution is wrong
findings.detail: The comment credits `{ messageType: 1, room: 1 }`, which cannot serve `sort({ createdAt: -1 })`; the planner will most likely use `{ room: 1, createdAt: -1 }` and filter messageType as a residual. Fix the comment.

findings.label: One page/limit for two independent lists
findings.detail: media and links share the same page/limit and the response carries no total or hasMore, so page 2 can return media with an empty links array and the client cannot distinguish an exhausted list from a short page. Fine today (the sheet only requests page 1); needs separate cursors or a hasMore before any load-more.
